svg.aria-label: Also in the works: A second robot platform, bringing up a larger, more agile robot base; Retail robotics, an interactive in-store robot built to catch shoppers' attention; Vision-based tracking, following moving targets in real time; Agri-tech, digital tools for farms and the supply chains around them; A property platform, for the local market; An offline-first mobile app, for exam preparation; A job-matching platform, connecting people with work
